build_now: Choose the smallest useful set of features from the user's scope that delivers the fastest aha moment through a complete core workflow, honoring explicit user priorities.

project_context.scope: Targeted redesign of the single Super Admin Library page (/super-admin/library) without touching or breaking the rest of the application. Aligns perfectly with the existing dark theme (near-black plum surfaces, crimson/red brand accent, Figtree font for UI, Roboto Mono for machine tokens and numbers), AdminCrumbs, AdminHeading, admin-panel, admin-test-row, StatusChip, and shadcn ui components.

actor_profile.user_mindset: Non-technical, high-stakes decision maker preparing a clean intake for JEE Mains and BITSAT chapter-wise PYQ and 62-day All India Test Series. Desires a powerhouse tool that feels effortlessly simple, normal, logical, and safe like an intuitive recycle bin.
critical_fears: Accidentally deleting student scores or past attempt histories
Losing track of unlinked uploads or older mocks
Touching or disrupting Rapidfire data (MUST NEVER BE TOUCHED)
Overwhelming complex jargon, nested database IDs, or confusing multi-level configurations
primary_goals: Have all cleared/retired tests cleanly organized and segmented into logical exam buckets (JEE Main, BITSAT, COMEDK, Custom)
Inspect exactly why and when tests were moved, their question counts, previous states, and kept student attempts
Perform instant 1-click restore or multi-select restore with clear plain-language guarantees
Have a clear post-clean-up guided roadmap on what to upload next

key_data_entities.description: Clean human-friendly test title (no internal file names or back-office strings shown to students)
Target exam category (e.g., JEE Main, BITSAT, COMEDK)
Mock type segment: PYQ Papers, Chapter-wise Tests (with subject: Physics/Chemistry/Maths), Mock Tests, All India Test Series (with day numbers), or custom sections
What it was before moving to Library (Live, Draft, Paused/Off, Scheduled)
Epoch timestamp of when the test was moved to Library (formatted in Indian locale: DD MMM YYYY)
Human-friendly reason tag, e.g. 'Fresh start clean-up on 15 Nov 2026', 'Replaced by a new PDF', 'Moved by you'
Number of preserved student attempts and recorded scores
For series papers (e.g., Day 14 of 62). If day slot is currently taken on restore, it restores without a day for safety
Unpublished source PDF uploads whose tests were never Live

scale_and_performance.item_volume: Up to ~3,000 tests total; typical post-clean-up steady state of 250 to 400 tests across 3 major exams
scale_and_performance.performance_rules: Client-side instant filtering and search with memoized segmentation; paginated/virtualized list beyond 150 items; immediate optimistic selection state; sticky action bar on viewport bottom.

industry_benchmarks.product: macOS Trash / Google Drive Trash / Gmail Bin
industry_benchmarks.observed_pattern: Non-destructive holding area with one-click 'Put back' / 'Restore' where items return to their original container seamlessly.
industry_benchmarks.adaptation: Tests retain their exact exam + section routing and previous state (Live returns to Live, Draft to Draft). If a scheduled day in a test series is occupied, safe unassigned fallback occurs.

industry_benchmarks.observed_pattern: Top segmented exam pills with live counter badges, search filter bar, and sticky batch action tray for multi-item restore.
industry_benchmarks.adaptation: Segmented tab controls by Exam (All, JEE Main, BITSAT, COMEDK, Custom) with count badges, secondary mock-type filter, and floating bottom bulk-restore bar.

layout_tradeoff_evaluation.option_a: Hierarchical Nested Accordion Tree (Folder per Exam > Subfolder per Mock Type > Table)
layout_tradeoff_evaluation.option_b_chosen: Segmented Exam Pill Navigation + High-Affordance Summary Header + Collapsible Section Group Panels + Sticky Batch Bar
layout_tradeoff_evaluation.decision_rationale: Option A requires multiple clicks and hides items behind collapsed folders, creating anxiety that items might be lost. Option B presents immediate visibility of total items, clear exam tabs (JEE Main, BITSAT, COMEDK), search with zero friction, and clear group headers with 'Restore all' buttons. Crucially, Option B is mobile-first responsive (390px viewport friendly).

research_and_design_decisions.rapidfire_safety_guarantee: Rapidfire data is strictly separated in the backend and explicitly highlighted as untouched and safe on the guidance panel, reinforcing confidence for the owner.

visual_system.direction_choice: Technical Dark Enterprise with Warm Crimson Accents (JEELIVE Brand Register)
visual_system.rationale: Preserves consistency with the existing JEELIVE.AI Super Admin theme: rich dark plum-tinted charcoal backgrounds, high-contrast crisp typography, tactile borders, and distinctive crimson brand accents for key calls-to-action.

typography.rules: Internal admin UI uses Figtree for all headings, labels, buttons, and row titles. Monospace (Roboto Mono) is strictly reserved for machine tokens, questions counts, attempt tallies, and date values with tabular figures.

accessibility_and_contrast.brand_crimson_on_card: Contrast ratio > 5.9:1 (Passes AA for standard text, AAA for large/bold)
accessibility_and_contrast.touch_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px on all touch devices

guidance_panel.purpose: Layman education and peace of mind for the platform owner

sections.heading: How the Library works (Recycle Bin rules)
bullets: Nothing is permanently lost: Every question, diagram, answer key, and explanation stays intact.
Student scores are protected: Students cannot start these tests now, but any past student can still see their scorecard in their history.
Restoring is 1-click: Restoring a test puts it right back to where it was (a Live test returns Live; a Draft returns to Draft).
Series test safety: If an All India Test Series day slot is already filled by a newer test, the restored test comes back safely without a day number so nothing is overwritten.

sections.heading: Recommended Next Steps (Fresh Start Intake)
sections.callout: Now that older mocks are cleared into the Library, upload your fresh content in Master:
steps: 1. Upload JEE Main Chapter-wise PYQ (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) in Master › JEE Main › Chapter-wise Tests.
2. Upload JEE Main 62-Day All India Test Series papers in Master › JEE Main › All India Test Series (your scheduled dates are already saved!).
3. Upload BITSAT Chapter-wise PYQ and BITSAT All India Test Series.
4. Rapidfire data remains untouched and ready for student speed drills.
